source_lines: """Pad with True rows up to the TP multiple, then take this rank's chunk.
The output row layout matches ``sp_shard`` so the mask stays aligned with
the sharded hidden states. Same ``if sp_pad > 0`` pad guard as the
upstream ``sp_padding_mask``. A custom op keeps the modulo padding
invisible to dynamo (same shape-baking hazard as ``sp_shard``), so like
``sp_shard`` the no-pad slice is cloned to avoid returning a view of an
input from a functional custom op.
return out.clone() if sp_pad == 0 else out

actual_profile.scope: Startup dummy/warmup/creation; not formal C8 baseline timing.
actual_profile.catalog_empty_exact_20_to24_field_correc: The old diagnostic required the entire serialized inputShapes string to equal 20. PadV3 has compound inputShapes 20;2;, so the empty list did not mean absent execution. Exact CPU call, source line and per-native datatype/shape audit locate all 32 actual BOOL20->BOOL24 public calls.

declared_domain.input: One-dimensional arbitrary Boolean is_padding of length n; TP size p>=1, rank 0<=r<p.
declared_domain.contract: Preserve Boolean values/dtype, output length, rank row ownership and a result that does not alias input. Input is not modified.
declared_domain.allowed: Replace the whole functional padding-and-rank-slice computation and its internal representation.
declared_domain.additional_guard: No required observer relies on the original full padded base allocation, its storage_offset or intermediate INT8 tensors. If such an observer exists, retain its observable contract or narrow the candidate.
declared_domain.not_this_domain: Deleting an individual native MemSet in the old captured graph without proving its private workspace/readiness contract.

derivation.output: out[j]=is_padding[r*c+j] when r*c+j<n, otherwise True, for 0<=j<c.
derivation.proof: F.pad appends exactly (-n) mod p True values. Restricting that padded vector to the returned rank interval gives the formula pointwise. The no-pad branch clones its slice, so a replacement must preserve no input aliasing. The formula covers n=0, n divisible by p, positive padding, partial local chunks and fully padded local chunks.

logical_external_array_bytes_in_byte_add.basis: Arbitrary demanded BOOL inputs must be read and fresh materialized BOOL outputs written once in a byte-addressed uncached external-array model. This is a conditional necessary logical I/O floor, not measured HBM traffic, wire bytes or time; zero-length output requires zero array bytes.

derivation.review_limit: Algebra plus finite checks; not formal verification of native fusion, storage lifetime or a performance claim.

conclusion: The entire public semantic boundary is a supported combination/reorganization candidate. Individual private native work is not proven removable. No more private MemSet argument probes are needed for this whole-function semantic conclusion.

ceiling.formula: T>=B_required/B_external_upper only in the stated uncached byte-addressed materialized domain; actual required physical transfers and B_external_upper remain unknown.
